title: G1 geometry worksheet - Mode II - APSD-LATHE

ai_unclear_or_missing.item: External thread designation, standard, class, thread depth and major-diameter tolerance
ai_unclear_or_missing.why: UNKNOWN in CAD; threadCreator text and majorDiameter=25 are not usable. OP80 uses an ASSUMED ISO 60 deg basic depth of 0.6134 x P = 3.067 mm on major D50 (assumption A10).
The modelled thread runs to a=85, the fillet tangent (F22), with no undercut or runout. A single-point thread cannot end there. OP80 ends at Z-120 (a=90) as an assumption.

ai_unclear_or_missing.item: Internal thread p=2: designation and producibility
ai_unclear_or_missing.why: Designation is UNKNOWN. T09 cannot cut it: its 12 mm bar does not fit a D12 bore, and its reach of 15 mm is less than the 41.42 mm length.

ai_unclear_or_missing.item: D12 vs D14 bore and face-area mismatches
ai_unclear_or_missing.why: The Hole feature says D14, the geometry says D12, and the F03/F19 areas do not close with either value.

ai_unclear_or_missing.item: Tool for the D12 bore from solid
ai_unclear_or_missing.why: The tool table has no D12 or smaller drill, except the T10 spot drill with reach 10. T05 D13 would oversize the bore. The boring bars need a pilot hole.

ai_unclear_or_missing.item: D13 bore depth vs drill reach
ai_unclear_or_missing.why: From the front the bore ends 168.58 mm deep, but T05 reach is 70 mm. From the rear, a D13 drill would destroy the D12 section. Only a=~145..170 is producible.
UNKNOWN (not returned by the API). It is also unknown whether the drilled D13 is acceptable as a finished bore.
None modelled, so none are programmed and all edges are sharp.
The team has not specified it (accepted). The programs assume nothing protrudes in front of S2 Z-82, i.e. a protected grip on D50.
The real part carries 29 mm of excess length beyond a=0 (240 - 210 - 1). The LatheLab stock dialog for S2 loads a raw bar with only 1 mm face allowance.

ai_unclear_or_missing.item: Meaning of tool 'reach' for OD turning tools
ai_unclear_or_missing.why: The S1 shoulder at a=80 is 25 mm radial (D50 to D100) and the S2 shoulder at a=60 is 15 mm, against T01/T02 reach of 15. These may be flagged by LatheLab.
